cost: O(n^3/epsilon) time and O(n^2/epsilon) cells; work=n*width+input length, an upper bound on DP cell visits plus input count, not exact CPU instructions. Multiple validation scans are constant factors. Checked usize/u128 dimensions; fallible reservation; no capacity-sized array.
description: Nonnegative integer item profits and usize weights; capacity, one supported percent and caller work budget. Scale q_i=floor(100*n*v_i/(percent*vmax)) exactly. DP stores minimum feasible weight per scaled profit, ties greater original value. Return maximum retained original objective V and D=percent*vmax, so OPT-V<=D/100<=percent*OPT/100.

inverse: Output value zero admits empty input and all-infeasible/zero-profit inputs. Positive objective admits permutations, redundant infeasible items and distinct optimal subsets. A reported value does not identify item indices; certificate and work narrow but do not uniquely invert these fibers.
